functions.gps_is_admin():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.gps_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(auth.role() = 'service_role', false)
    or (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.profiles p
        where p.id = auth.uid()
          and p.role = 'admin'
      )
      and public.is_authorized_admin_email()
    );
$function$
functions.is_authorized_admin_email():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_authorized_admin_email()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select lower(btrim(coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', ''))) = 'allowlisted-admin@example.test';
$function$
functions.jwt_is_admin():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jwt_is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(auth.role() = 'service_role', false)
    or (
      (
        coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '') in ('admin', 'super_admin')
        or coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'app_role', '') in ('admin', 'super_admin')
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.profiles p
          where p.id = auth.uid()
            and p.role = 'admin'
        )
      )
      and public.is_authorized_admin_email()
    );
$function$
functions.is_verified_supplier(uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_verified_supplier(p_uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.supplier_profiles s
    where s.id = p_uid and s.status = 'verified'
  );
$function$
functions.protect_profile_authorization_fields():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_profile_authorization_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.role is distinct from old.role
     and current_user not in ('postgres', 'supabase_admin', 'service_role') then
    raise exception 'profile authorization fields are not user-editable'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
